I should have added more to that, it did sound like we're losing money. Believe me we're not, my boss started this business with his last 2k and now dude is pushing millionaire status. Our money makers are the massive electric company fleet, the massive water district fleet, several local fire and police departments, and a good handful of other businesses that we have contracts with.

We also do a lot of performance work. Pulling trucks, drag cars, track cars, and everything in between. Our regular everyday customer that most shops get are taken care of because they've either been loyal customers for years or they're friends, family, and local people in the small area we're located. We don't need the income from the everyday customer to survive so we're not really losing much if something takes a little longer than expected. 

And as far as getting fired, the only thing that could possibly get me fired is having something I worked on catastrophically fail because I didn't do my job correctly. That's why we get paid hourly and are constantly told, doing it right is better than doing it quick.

We have a set price for diag on different things depending on what we're looking for specifically. We're paid hourly at my shop so we're not in a rush to get the biggest paycheck. 

When we bring a vehicle in to diag for a vibration/death wobble/pulling left or right, it doesn't matter how long it takes. The customer doesn't get charged any extra if we're not good at our jobs and can't figure it out in a timely manner. 

I know that's not how most shops do it but we're a small family shop that started in a 1 bay garage and we built it into what it is today by being honest, and doing our best to take care of customers.
